title: Reuse saved Dune query IDs for blueprint SQL updates
objective: Prevent private-query quota exhaustion by updating the existing saved query for a known blueprint when its SQL hash changes, then registering the new hash before execution.
owner_authorization: Owner authorized daily aggregate Dune collection. This task only changes saved-query reuse behavior; it must not execute Dune, PostgreSQL, Hermes, or CardKit before independent audit GREEN.
forbidden_actions: Do not execute Dune, PostgreSQL, Hermes, lark-cli, or migrations in tests.
Do not send a CardKit brief before independent audit GREEN.
Do not print, persist, or commit Dune keys, Lark tokens, DATABASE_URL, chat IDs, target lookup responses, or raw provider payloads.
Do not add metric families, chain CA/RPC adapters, trading, signing, backfills, B3, R2, hourly profiles, Four.meme, stablecoin, bridge, TVL, FDV/market-cap, or cohorts.
